recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It preserves the requested number-search examples while ensuring the examples point to current build-scope resources and search parameters.
issue_request: FHIR-7993 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for the FHIR-core search page asking to add a simple example for one of the number search parameters; the resolution was to add an example.
initial_application: The historical application is svn revision 6516, imported as git commit a122cda786a61c7fbda7c9a4b32fded1d53cb72c, which added number search example rows to source/search.html.
additional_context: Later Published corrections FHIR-17436 and FHIR-17590 changed the original Encounter length example to RiskAssessment probability and fixed the ImmunizationRecommendation dose-number typo. FHIR-19340 later removed ImmunizationRecommendation dose-number search parameters, ImmunizationRecommendation is no longer active in core source/fhir.ini, and the extension-pack checkout has ImmunizationRecommendation pages but no dose-number SearchParameter. Current core has active RiskAssessment and ResearchStudy number SearchParameters.
reconciliation: Changed source/search.html to replace GET/POST ImmunizationRecommendation?dose-number=2 with ResearchStudy?recruitment-target=100, using an active current core ResearchStudy number search parameter, and corrected the adjacent RiskAssessment description from 'great than' to 'greater than'.
source_changes: source/search.html: replaced the stale ImmunizationRecommendation dose-number number-search example with an active ResearchStudy recruitment-target number-search example and corrected the adjacent RiskAssessment wording typo.
